summary: CCD AS (org. no. 987 383 410) is a private limited company (AS) based in Gjesdal, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2004-10-23. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 74.110 (Industri-, produkt- og motedesignvirksomhet); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 46 250 and net income was -NOK 92 068. CEO: Hans Joachim Gerhard Kotthaus; board chair: Hans Joachim Gerhard Kotthaus.
